name: ModifyDBClusterArch

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:
on: Enables the hot standby cluster.
The equal (peer cluster) feature has been retired and is unavailable. Clusters with HotStandbyCluster set to StandbyClusterON do not support switching the high-availability mode by using this operation
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启热备集群。取值为 on，表示开启热备集群。equal（对等集群）功能已下线，不可使用；当前 HotStandbyCluster=StandbyClusterON 的集群不支持通过本接口切换高可用模式
parameters.name: hot_standby_cluster

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to view region details
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域信息详情
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone of the hot standby storage cluster. Valid values:

auto (default): Automatically selects the zone.
You can use the default value when the HotStandbyCluster parameter is set to on. When the HotStandbyCluster parameter is set to equal, you must specify a zone. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to view zone details.

When you specify a zone, you must not allocate a zone that is already in use by the cluster. You can query the currently active zones through the ZoneIds parameter of DescribeDBClusterAttribute
parameters.help_zh:
存储热备集群的可用区。取值范围如下：

auto（默认）：自动选取。
HotStandbyCluster参数为on时可以用默认值， HotStandbyCluster参数为equal时必须用具体的可用区参数https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看可用区信息详情。

指定具体可用区时，不得与集群已分配的可用区重复。可通过 DescribeDBClusterAttribute 的 ZoneIds 查询当前已用可用区
parameters.name: standby_az

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): Uses coupons.
false: Does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
